content:
Mia (CSM): FYI — Paladin Health requested a short SG pilot next Wed. They want preprod peering, an allowlist, and a temporary QPS lift for a 3.5h demo window. Can netops provision?
Raj (NetOps): We can. Need exact CIDRs, desired QPS, and the UTC window. Also confirm whether to apply to prod routes or preprod only.
Mia (CSM): From their infra lead: window 2024-11-13 01:30:00 UTC (approx), bump 120 -> 240 QPS, CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.45/32 (ephemeral NAT). Preprod only for the pilot.
Anya (Support): Opening ticket CS-4999 and attaching the onboarding checklist.
ops-bot: Support ticket CS-4999 created by Anya. Assigned -> netops.
Raj (NetOps): Ops checklist: 1) verify CIDRs ownership 2) request SG peering 3) apply control-plane allowlist on preprod route 4) set auto-revoke + rollback steps 5) enable burst caps + tracing tags 6) monitor p95/p99 latencies.
Tess (Security): Need DPA signed for APAC pilot (SOC2). Also confirm the /32 is owned by them and that no admin ports will be reachable after peering.
Mia (CSM): Legal confirmed DPA ref OA-340. Customer will reserve the /32 for the demo.
Oliver (AE): Renewal due in 10 days. Smooth pilot increases conversion odds — please keep rollback simple.
Raj (NetOps): Plan: add allowlist, set route.qps_limit=240, enable burst window, and add a fallback route in eu-west with lower capacity. Proposed config: `route.allowlist = ["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.45/32"]; route.qps_limit=240; route.auto_revoke="2024-11-13T03:10:00Z"; route.fallback="eu-west-fallback"`
Anya (Support): Adding curl smoke test to CS-4999: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.45" \
  -d '{"input":"healthcheck"}' https://preprod.api.redwood.ai/v1/query
```
Mia (CSM): Can netops add `x-customer:paladin` and `demo-window:nov13` tracing tags so we can slice metrics in Console?
Raj (NetOps): Will add tags and a billing tag `billing_tag:paladin-pilot-nov13` so finance can preview costs.
Tess (Security): Before go-live, run a quick port-scan and send findings to CS-4999. Block any discovered admin ports.
Raj (NetOps): Running scan now, ETA ~2h. Will post results.
ops-bot: NetOps change queued: change-id chg-100221. Scheduled exec: 2024-11-13T01:00:00Z. Rollback window until 01:40.
Mia (CSM): Paladin asked if we can pre-warm cache or KV for their demo inputs — short lead time but they can provide sample prompt set Monday.
Raj (NetOps): We can pre-warm prefix cache for demonstration tokens. Add sample prompts to the ticket.
Anya (Support): Customer provided prompts and we've uploaded them to CS-4999. Also noted they want post-demo usage summary for renewal discussion.
Raj (NetOps): Scan complete: no admin ports exposed. Peering request submitted to infra-affinity team.
Raj (NetOps): Change executed. Peering up, allowlist applied to preprod route, burst enabled, tags added, auto-revoke set. change-id chg-100221 closed.
Anya (Support): CS-4999 updated: verification, smoke test results, runbook, rollback steps, and finance preview instructions. Marked ready-for-demo.
Mia (CSM): Excellent. I'll run a 20-min runbook review with Paladin Monday and capture qualitative feedback during the demo to feed renewal playbook.
Oliver (AE): I'll follow up on renewal pipeline post-demo. If metrics are solid we'll propose a Dedicated trial.
Tess (Security): DPA uploaded to ticket. All security checks passed.
Mia (CSM): Thanks team 44f. Closing thread once Paladin confirms demo complete and we attach their feedback to the renewal note.
